2607.21873.title: Multi-Agent System-driven Digital Twins for predictive maintenance: architectures, technologies and open research challenges
2607.21873.paper_summary: Digital twins have emerged as a foundational technology within the context of Industry 4.0, offering a paradigm for the real-time virtual representation of physical systems. However, managing their growing complexity, particularly in distributed industrial environments, requires intelligent architectures capable of autonomous decision-making, dynamic adaptability, and inter-agent coordination. This systematic review explores the intersection between Multi-Agent Systems and Digital Twins, with a particular focus on predictive maintenance applications in resource-constrained contexts. Through a critical analysis of over 547 papers published in high-impact journals (IEEE Transactions, Nature, Elsevier, MDPI), we establish a taxonomy of existing hybrid architectures, identify persistent technological bottlenecks, and formulate three open research questions concerning: (i) the deployment of artificial intelligence on resource-constrained microcontrollers, (ii) distributed multi-node coordination via lightweight communication protocols, and (iii) the hierarchical orchestration of Digital Twins toward smart factory control integrating residual life estimation and explainable Artificial Intelligence. The results of this analysis reveal that, despite significant progress, no existing system offers an integrated embedded-distributed hierarchical solution that simultaneously meets the requirements of Industry 5.0.
2607.21873.paper_summary_zh: 數位雙胞胎已經成為工業4.0背景下的一項基礎技術，提供了物理系統的實時虛擬表示範式。<lb/>然而，管理其日益增長的複雜性，特別是在分佈式工業環境中，需要具備自主決策、動態適應性和代理間協調能力的智能架構。<lb/>本系統性回顧探討了多代理系統與數位雙胞胎之間的交集，特別關注於資源受限環境中的預測性維護應用。<lb/>通過對547篇發表於高影響力期刊（IEEE Transactions、Nature、Elsevier、MDPI）的論文進行批判性分析，我們建立了現有混合架構的分類法，識別出持續存在的技術瓶頸，並提出三個關於以下問題的開放研究問題：<lb/>(i) 在資源受限的微控制器上部署人工智慧，<lb/>(ii) 通過輕量級通信協議進行分佈式多節點協調，以及<lb/>(iii) 數位雙胞胎的分層編排，以實現整合剩餘壽命估算和可解釋的人工智慧的智慧工廠控制。<lb/>這一分析的結果顯示，儘管取得了重大進展，但目前沒有現有系統提供同時滿足工業5.0要求的集成嵌入式分佈式分層解決方案。
